banner: GENERATOR, NOT EVIDENCE. Nothing in this file is a result. It is a ranked list of hypotheses produced by an automated sweep over the EXPLORATION window only, with in-sample effect sizes. No line here may be quoted, cited, or reported as a finding. strata.note: TRANCHE A (HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md §P7-2), declared BEFORE the run and frozen in the config hash by its own sha256 (§P6-3(3)+(5)). TWO STRATA IN ONE DECLARED VECTOR. `f9_20_negative_controls` is the F9-20 arm-1 battery: 23 declared certain-zero-effect features x 31 lags = 713 PRICED tests, which §P7-2(a) rules must be counted in the multiplicity and must enter the BH vector as their own stratum -- because an unpriced control is an unaudited channel through which arbitrary features can be run and read, and because F10-25's survivor ratio only means anything if the two arms face the same threshold. `real_declared` is the already-declared K-089-R tranche-1 sweep (session_20260812T004857, 550 tests): already-declared is NOT free -- it still occupies its 550 slots in this session's BH denominator -- but it is NOT new scope and is not presented as any. q_s is FLAT at the declared q in both strata: no budget is reallocated between the arms, so there is no prior to justify under §P6-3(2), and the two arms are as close to a common threshold as a stratified procedure permits. The residual difference is the BH line q_s/m_s -- 0.10/713 in the control stratum against 0.10/550 in the real stratum -- and it is reported per stratum rather than hidden, together with the S-8 max-statistic, which is the partition-INVARIANT instrument and is the confirmatory number under arbitrary dependence.

size_mismatch.direction_of_bias: the null arm is the LARGER search (713 vs 500 count-path rows), so its selected median is stochastically the larger; the comparison therefore UNDER-states the real arm's excess and cannot manufacture one.
size_mismatch.derivation: a fixed upper order statistic of a larger sample drawn from the same distribution is stochastically larger; both arms are drawn under the same null by construction, so n is the only asymmetry left. Derived, not asserted -- S-18 candidate clause 4.

R3_F9_17_winners_curse.what_this_does_not_buy: a debiased estimate. The label is a LABEL: it says the number is an upper bound, not how much of it is selection. Nothing here licenses quoting any amplitude as an effect size.

S15_by_stratum.conventions: S-18: every number here carries its convention. alpha is TWO-SIDED and is q_s/m_s, the stratum's most conservative BH rung; power is fixed at 80%; A_min is a SINUSOIDAL rate-modulation amplitude as a fraction of the baseline rate; N is the domain event count in the mining window. The second reference (5.6%) is the programme's own standing bound, carried so a MEASURABLE verdict at the declared 20% cannot be read as measurable at an amplitude this programme would care about.

The §P7-10(b) curve is SUPERSEDED and is not used.

supervisor_annotation:
## SUPERVISOR ANNOTATION -- three things the automated banner above does not say

*Added by the parent after the run, 2026-08-13. No number computed by the session is
changed, added to, or removed by this section; it states three readings of numbers
already printed above that a reader would otherwise have to derive.*

### 1. Zero survivors here is a MEASUREMENT, not a resolution artifact

The console line "1263 of 1263 declared tests have a resolution floor ABOVE the BH
threshold" is computed against the FLAT threshold `q/m = 0.10/1263 = 7.9e-5`, which
is not the threshold this session actually operated at. Under the declared partition
the smallest BH rung is `q_s/m_s` **inside each stratum**: `0.10/713 = 1.40e-4` in the
control stratum and `0.10/550 = 1.82e-4` in the real stratum. The resolution floors
are `1.00e-4` (Monte Carlo, 10,000 surrogates) and `1.31e-4` (the exhaustive
circular-shift enumeration, set by record length). **Both stratified rungs sit ABOVE
both floors, so a single test in either arm could have rejected and none did.** The
smallest p anywhere in the session is `1.9e-3` (a mark test), an order of magnitude
away from its own rung. The flat-threshold line stays in the report unedited because
it is what the engine computes and correcting it in place would hide the difference;
this note is the correction.

### 2. The control arm's `max obs/floor = 1.412` is one under-resolved line, and the
catalog already said so

Every one of the 62 control rows with `p < 0.05`, and the whole of the control arm's
`max obs/floor = 1.412`, comes from exactly two of the 23 controls:
`nc_jupiter_saturn_synodic_phase` (7253 d, **1.06 cycles in a 7716 d window**) and
`nc_metonic_phase` (6940 d, 1.11 cycles). **Excluding those two lines, the smallest p
among the remaining 651 control rows is 0.056 and the largest `obs/floor` is 0.942.**

`MINING_CATALOG.md` declares both of them **"S15: UNMEASURABLE by window"** in their
own entries (F1-36, F2-09). The S-15 machinery in this report does not reproduce that
verdict, and the gap is worth naming precisely: the §P7-1(b) floor formula prices
MULTIPLICITY and DISPERSION at a given `N`, and says nothing about whether the record
is long enough to identify the cycle at all. A sinusoid observed over 1.06 periods is
not separable from a trend, its fitted amplitude is not an amplitude, and no floor
computed from `N` alone will notice. **The formula's `MEASURABLE` verdict on those two
rows is a formula output and must not be read as a claim that a 19.9-year cycle is
measurable in a 21-year window.** The catalog's per-entry declaration is the stricter
and correct one and it governs.

That this is visible at all is the battery working as designed: the two lines were put
in the catalog precisely as mechanism-free calibration rulers, and what they measured
is a limit of the floor formula rather than anything about the Earth.

### 3. F10-24's instability is real, and its SIZE is an upper bound

The two data-resampled audit runs produced **64 and 258 rows passing FDR** against
**zero** in the priced session. They are audit runs, they are priced at 0, they are
demote-only, and nothing in them may promote anything -- but the number is diagnostic
about the RESAMPLE and it must be read before the rank correlation is.

A moving-block bootstrap that re-indexes the target, the ETAS offset, the features and
the marks on ONE common index preserves alignment inside each block, which is what
makes it a stability instrument rather than a null. It also **duplicates blocks**:
4651 and 4086 of 7716 window days were distinct in the two draws. A duplicated block
duplicates whatever chance alignment it contains, while the block-bootstrap null
re-drawn inside the resampled series does not know the series was built that way. The
resampled data therefore carries stronger effective dependence than its own null
assumes, and the 64/258 survivor counts are the size of that effect.

**Direction, derived rather than asserted (S-18 candidate clause 4).** A resample that
inflates false positives injects independent noise into the ordering, and independent
noise can only reduce a rank correlation, never raise it. **So the measured
`rho = 0.487` and `rho = 0.044` are LOWER bounds on the ranking's true stability, and
the instability verdict they carry is an UPPER bound on its fragility.** The verdict
"the ranking moves when the data moves" stands as measured. The claim "the ranking is
noise" does not follow from these numbers alone, and is not made here.

Two further numbers belong beside the correlations, because the rank statistic alone
compresses them away: the top-100 **set overlap** is 83/100 between the priced session
and the first resample, against 22/100 between the two resamples. Membership near the
top is considerably more stable than order within it against the original run, and
considerably less stable between two independent resamples -- which is itself a
statement about the variance of this resampling scheme rather than about the Earth.

### What none of this licenses

Nothing. This session is a GENERATOR on the exploration window under a v1 ETAS
baseline; it is blind through the diurnal and semidiurnal band by two exact zeros of
day-binning and global longitude summation, blind to the second phase moment, gated by
G-M1, and forbidden from being entered for or against any ledger entry. It emitted no
stub. A survivor in the control stratum would have been a measured false positive; a
survivor in the real stratum would have been a hypothesis stub and nothing more. There
were none of either.
